answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one atlas weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 47 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 100 times the capital for one share. The bridge report shows the merge explicitly at each jetty. A farm of 1405 identities would post 1806 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
